COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPMS No.2041 of 2023
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. R.P. Singh, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. Suyash Pant, Standing Counsel
for the State.
Mr. Rahul Consul, Advocate for the 
respondent no.1/the authority. 
Serious allegations have been raised 
in this petition. It is the case of the 
petitioner that a complex is being raised 
adjacent to the property of the petitioner 
without due approvals; in utter violation of 
the bylaws of Mussorie Dehradun 
Development Authority, Dehradun (“the 
authority”). The wife of the petitioner has 
repeatedly been informing the officers of the 
authority, but nothing has been done.
Learned counsel for the petitioner 
seeks amendment in the petition on the 
ground that, in fact, the premises had been 
sealed on 01.07.2023. 
List this matter on 28.08.2023.
 (Ravindra Maithani J.) 
03.08.2023
RV

WPMS No.2041 of 2023
Sudhir Kumar Chouhdary …………Petitioner
Vs.
Secretary Mussoorie Dehradun 
and others ……….Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Shashi Kant Shandilya, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Rahul Consul, Advocate for M.D.D.A./respondent 
no.1.
3. Mr. Suyash Pant, S.C. for the State/respondent nos.2 
to 4.
4. Ms. Anupriya Kukreti, Advocate for respondent no.5.
5. Vide earlier order dated 17.02.2026 counsel for 
respondent no.1-M.D.D.A was directed to seek instructions 
in the matter.
6. On the same day, respondent no.1-M.D.D.A. sent a 
letter to the respondent no5. to visit the Office of M.D.D.A. 
with the compounding map and requisite documents in 
order to ascertain that as to whether the work is going 
according to the sanctioned map or not.
7. It is submitted by learned counsel for the respondent 
no.5 that she was asked to remain present in the Office of 
respondent no.1-M.D.D.A. on 10.03.2026.
8. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that 
respondent no.5 would visit the Office as required by the 
respondent no.1-M.D.D.A. on 10.03.2026, therefore, the 
matter be adjourned for some next date after 10.03.2026.
9. Learned counsel for the petitioner however submits 
that despite pendency of the writ petition respondent no.5 is  2
still continuing with the construction activity on the 
property in-question.
10. List this case on 20.03.2026.
11. Learned counsel for the respondent no.5 has made a 
statement on bar that till the next date of listing no 
construction work will be carried out by respondent no.5.
12. If any construction activity will be carried out by 
respondent no.5 that shall attract immediate contempt 
proceedings.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 26.02.2026
SK

 --Petitioner
Versus
Secretary MDDA and Ors.
 --Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Shashi Kant Shandilya, learned 
counsel for petitioner.
2. Mr. Suyash Pant, learned Standing 
Counsel with Mr. Bhupendra Singh 
Koranga, learned Brief Holder for the State 
of Uttarakhand/respondent Nos.1 to 4. 
3. Ms. Anupriya Kukreti, learned counsel 
for respondent No.5.
4. After hearing parties, it transpires that 
construction has been raised by 
respondent No.5 beyond the sanctioned 
map. He was proceeded by the 
respondent-MDDA for raising construction 
by him beyond the sanctioned map; 
compounding application has been filed, 
which was allowed with undertaking given 
by respondent No.5 that the portion which 
has not been compounded will be removed 
by him.
5. Compounding was done by the 
respondent-MDDA on 26.09.2025, but, till 
date, portion which has to be demolished 
by respondent No.5 on the basis of 
undertaking given by him during 
compounding, has yet not been 
demolished.
6. Respondent No.5 shall file an affidavit  before this Court after demolishing the 
portion, which was required to be 
demolished as per compounding order on 
which he has given undertaking, within 10 
days from today.
7. Put up on 02.04.2026.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 20.03.2026

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPMS No.2041 of 2023
Sudhir Kumar Choudhary …………Petitioner
Vs.
Secretary, Mussoorie 
Dehradun and others ……….Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Vishwaketu Vaidya, learned counsel holding brief of 
Mr. Shashi Kant Shandilya, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Rahul Consul, learned counsel for respondent no.1.
3. Mr. Devendra Pant, learned S.C. for the 
State/respondent nos.2 to 4.
4. Ms. Anupriya Kukreti, learned counsel for respondent 
no.5.
5. This Court vide order dated 20.03.2026 directed 
respondent no.5 to file an affidavit before this Court within ten 
days from the date of order i.e., 20.03.2026 after demolishing 
the portion, which was required to be demolished as per 
compounding order on which he has given undertaking.
6. Learned counsel for respondent no.5 submits that 
respondent no.5 is Assistant Commandant in C.R.P.F., posted 
in Punjab, who applied for 15 days’ casual leave w.e.f., 
14.03.2026 to 08.04.2026. Petitioner reached Dehradun on 
20.03.2026, on leave, but on 23.03.2026 his leave was 
cancelled in view of the upcoming Assembly Elections 
scheduled to be held in five States and was directed to report 
Company Headquarter, Dera Baba Nanak, Gurdaspur, State of
Punjab, in the afternoon of 04.04.2026.
7. Leave cancellation order and other relevant documents 
passed on to this Court, are placed on record.
8. Since the leave has been cancelled the petitioner could 
not comply with the order passed by this Court, therefore,  2
petitioner seeks time to get the order complied with after some 
time as the elections are till 05.05.2026.
9. Accordingly list this case on 15.05.2026 for compliance 
of the order dated 20.03.2026.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 02.04.2026
SK
